Communities rebuild among ruined roads, scarce resources, strange hazards, and the legacies of a lost age.
A supply convoy must cross a broken causeway before a dust front. Rescue isolated travelers, bargain for passage and decide whether its reserves belong to buyers or communities.
A sealed greenhouse offers a harvest at the price of an old isolation protocol. Recover clean seed, investigate contamination and decide who may plant beyond its walls.
A failing power station can warm one settlement through the coming freeze. Repair its controls, expose unequal rationing and decide how the remaining heat is shared.
Keep vulnerable travelers safe before moving supplies
Test seed and rebuild shared infrastructure
Record ownership, shortages and maintenance duties

A three to four hour Dustroad Convoy game: A supply convoy must cross a broken causeway before a dust front. Rescue isolated travelers, bargain for passage and decide whether its reserves belong to buyers or communities.
Start with sealed barrels and a storm approaching the broken causeway.
State crossing capacity, masks and transport places before asking for choices.
Give contract holders needs of their own and allow witnessed delay.
Record who owns passage, pays repairs and receives emergency reserves.

A three to four hour Seed Vault game: A sealed greenhouse offers a harvest at the price of an old isolation protocol. Recover clean seed, investigate contamination and decide who may plant beyond its walls.
Open with a healthy outsider rejected by an old isolation protocol.
Distinguish uncertain contamination from automatic guilt.
Offer a viable sample, independent testing and seed-heir participation.
Record immediate food, next season’s reserve and who may plant.

A three to four hour Last Grid game: A failing power station can warm one settlement through the coming freeze. Repair its controls, expose unequal rationing and decide how the remaining heat is shared.
Show warm warehouses and cold homes missing from the roll.
Make the old industrial priority a fixable process rather than magic.
Offer shared cycles and a manual override at visible costs.
Record household representation and responsibility for the return cable.
